messages:
nora: Quick RFC follow-up — re: quota reservoir + fairness scheduler interactions. Thinking about a phased 'reservoir bridge' to avoid sudden deprivation when we move tenants off hard per-tenant caps. Need to define ingress <-> quota RPC boundary.

sam: Short summary of problem: if we move tenant A to reservoir while inflight admits are still charging the old ledger, we can under- or over-charge. Also fairness weights may change and reorder pending queues.

diego: Idea: three-phase admit flow: PREPARE (shadow), CUTOVER (phase id), SETTLE (final). Use a phase_id returned by quota manager to pin decisions for inflight requests.

lin: For compatibility: add optional headers: x-rwin-quota-mode=enforce|shadow|reservoir, x-rwin-phase-id, x-rwin-est-tokens, x-rwin-abuse-score. Gateway can synthesize them for legacy SDKs.

nora: Agree on headers but we should require mTLS/auth for accepting abuse_score/hints. Private/Dedicated frontdoors can't be trusted by default.

sam: Admission API change proposal: admit(tenant, est_tokens?, abuse_score?, mode?, phase_id?) -> decision enum {ACCEPT_CHARGE, ACCEPT_NO_CHARGE, RETRY_SAFE, DENY}. Return phase_id and canonical mode.

diego: Make server-side admission idempotent by caching phase_id->decision for N seconds. That covers retries. Also log reconciliation mismatches with request_id, phase_id, tenant.

lin: Rollout plan: shadow-only for 48h, collect metrics: reservoir.attached_tenants, reservoir.fallback_rate{tenant}, reconciliation_mismatches. Thresholds for auto-rollback: mismatch_rate > 0.5% or latency p95 regressed > 10%.

nora: Also need fairness scheduler changes: when tenants move to reservoir we should temporarily cap their effective weight to avoid reservoir knee-jerk hogging.

sam: Good catch. Implement 'cooldown weight' for T minutes after cutover; gradually ramp weight back over window.

diego: Tests: synthetic high-concurrency cutover test, duplicate/retry request test (simulate network flaps), and untrusted-hint test to ensure hints are ignored when auth missing.

lin: Ops note: schedule rollout job rollouts/reservoir-bridge on 2024-05-02 08:00 UTC: canary 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with manual gates.

ops-bot: Job queued: rollouts/reservoir-bridge v1 2024-05-02 08:00 UTC.

nora: Action items: sam -> proto change + doc; diego -> synthetic harness + idempotency cache; lin -> gateway shim + header mapping; i'll draft runbook for Dedicated/Private compatibility and trust boundary. Ping #release-war-room when PRs land. :thumbsup:
